## Checklist

- [ ] `npm ci && npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Behavior changes, new options, or default-tolerance/cost changes were
      discussed in an issue first.
- [ ] Tests cover the change and the invariants it can affect
      (order-independence, one-way traversal, non-persistent anchors, bounded
      connectors, stable distance/cost accounting).
- [ ] Long fallback bridges remain opt-in.
- [ ] Any compatibility or performance impact is described above.
